segments.name: controlKey
segments.description: letter, never I, O or U

segments.name: vatCode
segments.description: A, P, B, D or N

segments.name: categoryCode
segments.description: M, P, C, N or E

segments.name: secondaryEstablishment
segments.description: 000 for the head office; a non-zero value requires category E

validation.normalize: Remove spaces, slashes, dots and hyphens; upper-case; left-pad the leading digits to 7.
steps: Character 8 is a letter other than I, O, U.
In the long form: character 9 in A/P/B/D/N, character 10 in M/P/C/N/E, last three are digits.
If the last three digits are not 000 the category code must be E.
The rule that derives the control key from the digits is not implemented by the source; treat the key as unchecked.

testVectors.note: U is not a control key

claims.value: identifiant fiscal (7 digits + control letter), VAT code, category code, 3-digit establishment number
